tex_content.label: pinch
tex_content.html:
For a compact three-dimensional flow whose initial curvature-operator eigenvalues satisfy $\lambda (x,0)\ge \mu (x,0)\ge u (x,0)\ge -1$, set $X=\max (- u ,0)$. Then

  1. $R(x,t)\ge -6/(4t+1)$;

  2. if $X(x,t)>0$, then

    \[ R(x,t)\ge 2X(x,t)(\log X(x,t)+\log (1+t)-3). \]

Proof

↗ prop:scalar-curvature-min-evolution ↗ thm:maximum-principle-tensors-varying-z \sketch The scalar estimate gives the first pinching inequality. For the second, apply the time-varying tensor maximum principle to the three helper claims below. Since $S=R/2$, the resulting inequalities imply the stated bound for $X\ge 1/(1+t)$; for $0<X\le 1/(1+t)$ use $S\ge -3X$ and $f_t(X)<-3X$.

□
